input.quote: (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services)
input.rationale: Section 5(a) imposes monthly minimum fees regardless of usage, and Section 6 removes any right to contest them, on a term that renews automatically for successive years — a take-or-pay with no reduction mechanism. We limited the minimums to the current 12-month term, made them reducible on 30 days' notice, and confirmed they are trued up rather than applied as a penalty and do not accrue after termination.

input.quote: If Client decides to discontinue Hosting Service, Client is responsible for arranging for a new hosting environment within 60 days.
input.rationale: Exit is handled only by placing the migration burden on Client (new name server in 30 days, new hosting environment in 60 days); there is no transition-assistance obligation, no return of our data in a usable format and no deletion certification, despite TrueLink holding the Web Site, borrower data and daily backups. We inserted the standard transition/data-return paragraph in the termination section.
